# Command reference

Every generated command, with the OSDU operation behind it. `osducs <noun> --help` shows the
same information at the terminal, and is the authority if the two ever disagree.

Commands are named for the **resource**, not the service that hosts it, so verbs live under
the thing they act on: searching records is `osducs record search`. See
[COMMAND-GRAMMAR.md](../COMMAND-GRAMMAR.md) for why.

Hand-written commands — `osducs status`, `osducs completion` — are not listed here; they have
no manifest. Run `osducs --help` for the full tree.


| Noun | Commands |
|---|---|
| [`crs`](#crs) | `get`, `transform`, `area-of-use`, `convert`, `convert-trajectory`, `convert-geojson` |
| [`dataset`](#dataset) | `get`, `add`, `delete`, `undelete`, `upload-url`, `download-url`, `revoke-url` |
| [`file`](#file) | `get`, `add`, `delete`, `upload-url`, `download-url`, `revoke-url` |
| [`group`](#group) | `list`, `add`, `delete`, `member list`, `member add`, `member delete`, `member count` |
| [`legaltag`](#legaltag) | `list`, `get`, `add`, `update`, `delete`, `validate`, `properties` |
| [`measurement`](#measurement) | `list`, `get`, `search`, `maps` |
| [`member`](#member) | `group list`, `delete` |
| [`record`](#record) | `search`, `aggregate`, `list`, `get`, `headers`, `delete`, `version list`, `version get` |
| [`schema`](#schema) | `list`, `get`, `add`, `update` |
| [`unit`](#unit) | `list`, `get`, `search`, `by-symbol`, `by-measurement`, `by-system`, `preferred`, `maps`, `conversion scale`, `conversion abcd`, `catalog get`, `catalog search`, `catalog map-states`, `catalog last-modified` |
| [`unit-system`](#unit-system) | `list`, `get` |
| [`wellbore`](#wellbore) | `get`, `add`, `delete`, `version list`, `version get` |
| [`workflow`](#workflow) | `list`, `get`, `add`, `delete`, `run list`, `run get`, `run trigger`, `run update`, `run latest` |

## crs

### `osducs crs area-of-use`

Check which transformations are valid for a set of points.

`POST /v3/points-in-aou` — crs_catalog

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | yes | JSON file containing the points and the transformations to test. |

### `osducs crs convert`

Convert a list of points to another coordinate reference system.

`POST /v4/convert` — crs_conversion

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | yes | JSON file containing the points and the target CRS. |

### `osducs crs convert-geojson`

Convert a GeoJSON structure to another coordinate reference system.

`POST /v4/convertGeoJson` — crs_conversion

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | yes | JSON file containing the GeoJSON or AnyCrsGeoJson structure. |

### `osducs crs convert-trajectory`

Convert wellbore trajectory stations to another coordinate reference system.

`POST /v4/convertTrajectory` — crs_conversion

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | yes | JSON file containing the trajectory stations and the target CRS. |

### `osducs crs get`

Get a coordinate reference system by record or data id.

`GET /v3/coordinate-reference-system` — crs_catalog

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--record-id` |  | CRS record id. |
| `--data-id` |  | CRS data id. Give this or --record-id. |

> One of `--record-id` or `--data-id` is required.

### `osducs crs transform`

Get a coordinate transformation by record or data id.

`GET /v3/coordinate-transformation` — crs_catalog

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--record-id` |  | Transformation record id. |
| `--data-id` |  | Transformation data id. Give this or --record-id. |

> One of `--record-id` or `--data-id` is required.

## dataset

### `osducs dataset add`

Create or update dataset registry records from a JSON file.

`PUT /registerDataset` — dataset

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | yes | JSON file containing the dataset registry records. |

### `osducs dataset delete`

Soft-delete a dataset metadata record.

`POST /metadataRecord/{id}/softDelete` — dataset

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-id`, `--id` | yes | Dataset metadata record id. |

### `osducs dataset download-url`

Get instructions for reading a dataset's bytes.

`GET /retrievalInstructions` — dataset

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-id`, `--id` | yes | Dataset registry record id. |
| `--expiry` |  | How long the instructions stay valid, e.g. 5M or 2H. |

### `osducs dataset get`

Get a dataset registry record by id.

`GET /getDatasetRegistry` — dataset

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-id`, `--id` | yes | Dataset registry record id. |

### `osducs dataset revoke-url`

Revoke previously issued dataset URLs.

`POST /revokeURL` — dataset

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--kind-subtype` | yes | Dataset sub-type whose URLs should be revoked. |
| `-f`, `--file` | yes | JSON file naming the resource whose URLs should be revoked. |

### `osducs dataset undelete`

Restore a soft-deleted dataset metadata record.

`POST /metadataRecord/{id}/undelete` — dataset

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-id`, `--id` | yes | Dataset metadata record id to restore. |

### `osducs dataset upload-url`

Get instructions for writing a new dataset's bytes.

`POST /storageInstructions` — dataset

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--kind-subtype` |  | Dataset sub-type, e.g. dataset--File.Generic. |
| `--expiry` |  | How long the instructions stay valid, e.g. 5M or 2H. |

## record

### `osducs record aggregate`

Count distinct values of a field across matching records.

`POST /query` — search

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-k`, `--kind` | yes | Kind to aggregate over. Wildcards allowed per segment. |
| `-b`, `--by` | yes | Field to count distinct values of, e.g. kind. Only fields indexed as keywords can be aggregated; others answer "Aggregations are not supported for one or more of the specified fields". |
| `-q`, `--query` |  | Lucene query to narrow what is counted, e.g. data.FacilityName:GB*. |

```bash
osducs record aggregate --kind "osdu:wks:master-data--*:*" --by kind
osducs record aggregate --kind "osdu:wks:master-data--Well:*" --by kind --query 'data.FacilityName:GB*'
```

### `osducs record delete`

Soft-delete a record by id.

`POST /records/{id}:delete` — storage

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-id`, `--id` | yes | Record id to delete. |

### `osducs record get`

Get the latest version of a record by id.

`GET /records/{id}` — storage

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-id`, `--id` | yes | Record id. |
| `-a`, `--attributes` |  | Restrict the returned fields of the record. |

```bash
osducs record get --id "opendes:master-data--Wellbore:1000"
```

### `osducs record headers`

Fetch record headers by id, without the data payload.

`POST /query/records/headers` — storage

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-id`, `--id` | yes | Record id. Repeat the flag for up to 1000 records. |
| `-a`, `--attributes` |  | Header fields to return. Omit for all of them; 'id' is always included. |

```bash
osducs record headers --id "opendes:master-data--Wellbore:1000" -a kind -a acl
```

### `osducs record list`

List records of a given kind.

`GET /query/records` — storage

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-k`, `--kind` | yes | Kind of records to list. |
| `--limit` |  | Maximum number of records to return. |
| `--cursor` |  | Cursor returned by a previous page. |

```bash
osducs record list --kind "osdu:wks:master-data--Well:1.2.0" --limit 5
```

### `osducs record search`

Search records with a Lucene query.

`POST /query` — search

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-k`, `--kind` | yes | Kind to search. Wildcards are allowed per segment, so "osdu:wks:master-data--Well:*" covers every schema version — pinning one silently misses records written against the others. |
| `-q`, `--query` |  | Lucene query string, e.g. data.FacilityName:GB* for a prefix, or data.FacilityName:"GB 211/23-A8" for an exact phrase. Omit to match everything of this kind. |
| `--limit` |  | Maximum number of results. Defaults to 10 upstream, capped at 1000. |
| `--offset` |  | Number of results to skip. Use --cursor-based paging beyond 10000. |
| `--sort-by` |  | Fields to sort by, e.g. id or data.FacilityName. Pair positionally with --sort-order. |
| `--sort-order` |  | Sort direction per --sort-by field. Defaults to ASC upstream when omitted. |
| `--track-total-count` |  | Report the true match count. Without it the count is capped at 10000, which silently understates any large kind. |
| `-f`, `--returned-fields` |  | Fields to project, e.g. id, data.FacilityName. Repeat the flag or comma-separate. These become the table columns, so asking for a field shows it. Server-side, so it also cuts what crosses the wire. |
| `-x`, `--excluded-fields` |  | Fields to omit, e.g. data.rawData — everything else is returned. The inverse of --returned-fields and cannot be combined with it. Columns stay Id and Kind unless --returned-fields names others, since an exclusion says nothing about what to show. |
| `--spatial-field` |  | Geo-point field to filter on. Required with --bbox or --near; the OSDU convention is data.SpatialLocation.Wgs84Coordinates. |
| `--bbox` |  | Bounding box as TOPLAT,TOPLON,BOTTOMLAT,BOTTOMLON — note top-left first, so the latitudes descend. Example: 49.1,7.7,48.8,8.0. |
| `--near` |  | Centre point as LAT,LON, e.g. 48.935251,7.865344. Pair with --within. |
| `--within` |  | Radius in metres around --near. |

> `--returned-fields` and `--excluded-fields` cannot be combined.

> `--bbox` and `--near` cannot be combined.

```bash
osducs record search --kind "osdu:wks:master-data--Well:*" --limit 5
osducs record search --kind "osdu:wks:master-data--Well:*" --limit 3 -x data.GeoContexts -x data.NameAliases
osducs record search --kind "osdu:wks:master-data--Well:*" --spatial-field data.SpatialLocation.Wgs84Coordinates --bbox 49.1,7.7,48.8,8.0 --limit 3 -f id -f data.FacilityName
osducs record search --kind "osdu:wks:master-data--Well:*" --spatial-field data.SpatialLocation.Wgs84Coordinates --near 48.935251,7.865344 --within 50000 --limit 3 -f id -f data.FacilityName
osducs record search --kind "osdu:wks:master-data--Well:*" --query 'data.FacilityName:GB*' --limit 5
osducs record search --kind "osdu:wks:master-data--Well:*" --query 'data.FacilityName:"GB 211/23-A8"'
osducs record search --kind "osdu:wks:master-data--Well:*" --limit 5 -f id -f data.FacilityName
osducs record search --kind "osdu:wks:master-data--Well:*" --limit 5 --sort-by id --sort-order DESC
osducs record search --kind "osdu:wks:master-data--Well:*" --limit 1 --track-total-count
```

## schema

### `osducs schema add`

Create a schema from a JSON file.

`POST /schema` — schema_service

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | yes | JSON file containing the schema request (schemaInfo and schema). |

### `osducs schema get`

Get a schema by id.

`GET /schema/{id}` — schema_service

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-id`, `--id` | yes | Schema id, e.g. osdu:wks:master-data--Well:1.0.0. |

```bash
osducs schema get --id "osdu:wks:master-data--Well:1.0.0"
```

### `osducs schema list`

List schemas, optionally filtered by authority, source or entity type.

`GET /schema` — schema_service

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--authority` |  | Filter by authority, e.g. osdu. |
| `--source` |  | Filter by source, e.g. wks. |
| `-e`, `--entity-type` |  | Filter by entity type, e.g. master-data--Well. |
| `--status` |  | Filter by lifecycle status: PUBLISHED, DEVELOPMENT or OBSOLETE. |
| `--scope` |  | Filter by scope: SHARED or INTERNAL. |
| `--latest` |  | Return only the newest version of each schema. |
| `--limit` |  | Maximum number of schemas to return. |
| `--offset` |  | Number of schemas to skip. |

```bash
osducs schema list --limit 5
```

### `osducs schema update`

Create or replace a schema from a JSON file.

`PUT /schema` — schema_service

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | yes | JSON file containing the schema request (schemaInfo and schema). |

## wellbore

### `osducs wellbore add`

Add a Wellbore record from a JSON file.

`POST /ddms/v3/wellbores` — wellbore_ddms

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | yes | JSON file containing the Wellbore record. |

### `osducs wellbore delete`

Soft-delete a Wellbore record by id.

`DELETE /ddms/v3/wellbores/{record_id}` — wellbore_ddms

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-id`, `--id` | yes | Wellbore record id to delete. |

### `osducs wellbore get`

Get a Wellbore record by id.

`GET /ddms/v3/wellbores/{record_id}` — wellbore_ddms

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-id`, `--id` | yes | Wellbore record id. |

### `osducs wellbore version get`

Get a specific version of a Wellbore record.

`GET /ddms/v3/wellbores/{record_id}/versions/{version}` — wellbore_ddms

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-id`, `--id` | yes | Wellbore record id. |
| `-v`, `--version` | yes | Wellbore record version. |

### `osducs wellbore version list`

List all versions of a Wellbore record.

`GET /ddms/v3/wellbores/{record_id}/versions` — wellbore_ddms

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-id`, `--id` | yes | Wellbore record id. |

## workflow

### `osducs workflow add`

Register a workflow definition from a JSON file.

`POST /v1/workflow` — workflow

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | yes | JSON file containing the workflow definition. |

### `osducs workflow delete`

Delete a workflow definition by name.

`DELETE /v1/workflow/{workflow_name}` — workflow

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-n`, `--name` | yes | Workflow name to delete. |

### `osducs workflow get`

Get a workflow definition by name.

`GET /v1/workflow/{workflow_name}` — workflow

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-n`, `--name` | yes | Workflow name. |

### `osducs workflow list`

List workflows registered in the partition.

`GET /v1/workflow` — workflow

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--prefix` |  | Return only workflows whose name starts with this. |

### `osducs workflow run get`

Get one workflow run.

`GET /v1/workflow/{workflow_name}/workflowRun/{runId}` — workflow

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-n`, `--name` | yes | Workflow name. |
| `-r`, `--run` | yes | Run id. |

### `osducs workflow run latest`

Show execution detail for the most recent task of a run.

`GET /v1/workflow/{workflow_name}/workflowRun/{runId}/latestInfo` — workflow

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-n`, `--name` | yes | Workflow name. |
| `-r`, `--run` | yes | Run id. |

### `osducs workflow run list`

List the runs of a workflow.

`GET /v1/workflow/{workflow_name}/workflowRun` — workflow

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-n`, `--name` | yes | Workflow name. |

### `osducs workflow run trigger`

Start a new run of a workflow.

`POST /v1/workflow/{workflow_name}/workflowRun` — workflow

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-n`, `--name` | yes | Workflow name to run. |
| `-f`, `--file` | yes | JSON file containing the run request, including its executionContext. |

### `osducs workflow run update`

Update the status of a workflow run.

`PUT /v1/workflow/{workflow_name}/workflowRun/{runId}` — workflow

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-n`, `--name` | yes | Workflow name. |
| `-r`, `--run` | yes | Run id. |
| `--status` | yes | New status for the run. |
